title: One construction for the Miura-ori flip-graph degree sequence
summary: The flip graph of an origami crease pattern has the locally flat-foldable mountain-valley assignments as vertices, and an edge joins two of them that differ by a single face flip. A basic invariant of this graph is the degree sequence, which counts the vertices of each degree. On the $m\times n$ Miura-ori, this sequence is known to be a bivariate polynomial only for small degrees, each count obtained by a separate argument. This paper gives one uniform construction that expresses, for every degree $d$, the number of degree-$d$ vertices as a single symmetric polynomial in $(m,n)$ for all…
